The long-value class applies max-height: 150px and overflow: auto, with a visible keyboard-focus outline. Existing long-word wrapping remains in force. Rendered height, focus and scrolling require browser verification.
The JSON export still serializes the stored complete response object; long-value presentation does not change record contents or the export path.

The rank-infeasible status explicitly identifies threshold-event probability zero as deterministic and disclaims a calibrated guarantee. Its supporting paragraph retains the tau = 1 fallback and cutoff-below-one premise.

The index help explicitly distinguishes missing score probability p from zero. Its hash is already identical to the prior sealed source review, so this addendum does not claim a new index edit after that receipt.
Loss ceiling and significance are now separate labeled facts; both use full exact values. No change to mathematical calculations or the API request occurs.
Input invalidation, revision checks for stale responses and errors, no-outcomes request shape, hypothetical-premise validation and negative scientific wording remain intact.
